# Deterministic artifact listing

Produces a deterministic list of artifacts for a given repository tree so repeated collections yield byte-identical results (order and hashes). This supports reproducibility and equality checks across runs.

**Anchored to:**

- `tests/test_git_collector.py` — `tests.test_git_collector.test_artifacts_are_deterministic`
